title: Standard Endpoint Order Cancellation After the Purchase Order: Signed Cancellation and Fee
content:
## Scope

This Hardware Procurement rule settles the fee charged when the authorized contact's e-signed cancellation of a Standard Endpoint Order takes effect after the order's purchase order was placed and before it shipped. The signature records the cancellation and its fee together.

For a Standard Endpoint Order cancelled after its purchase order, and only for such an order, the cancellation fee is figured under this endpoint cancellation schedule; any deposit paid on it is still applied against that fee by an order credit, with the excess refunded by the accounting team. A Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order is settled under the infrastructure cancellation and deposit-credit schedules, and every other order type's cancellation after its purchase order stays charged its after-purchase-order cancellation fee percentage of the quote total, rounded half up to the cent, with any deposit paid applied against that fee by an order credit and the excess refunded by the accounting team.

## Effect of the signed cancellation

| What the client sees | Result |
|---|---|
| Order status | cancelled, recorded as cancelled after its purchase order, cancelled and closed on the day of signing |
| Signed request | a signed cancellation request on the order |
| Billing ledger | a cancellation fee invoice for the amount signed, added to what the client owes on the order |

## Invocation: `sign_order_cancellation_55862425`

**Capability.** The authorized contact e-signs the cancellation of the client's own hardware order whose distributor purchase order has already been placed and which has not shipped. One call records the signed cancellation request, moves the order to cancelled (cancelled after its purchase order, cancelled and closed today) and books the cancellation fee on the order's billing ledger as a new invoice, adding it to the amount the client owes on the order.

**How it is invoked.** `sign_order_cancellation_55862425` is a customer-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to sign. The service desk does not sign it on the client's behalf.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | client reference number of the verified client signing, as returned by the client profile lookup | identifier |
| `hardware_order_id` | reference number of the client's hardware order being cancelled, as returned by the hardware order lookup for this client | identifier |
| `fee_usd` | the cancellation fee the client signs for, in USD | a positive amount rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the signed request reference, the order reference, the order's new status cancelled, the cancellation fee invoice number (INV- followed by 6 digits) and the fee booked in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the cancellation and its fee are on record.
